# Robot.Safety

| Path | Kind | Definition | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Robot.Safety.Arm` | command | — · timeout 3000 ms · SUCCEEDED/REJECTED/FAILED/TIMED_OUT | Request arming (manual-ready). Never implicit. |
| `Robot.Safety.Controller` | sensor | enum {NONE, OPERATOR, WORKFLOW} maxAge 300 ms | Who currently holds control authority. |
| `Robot.Safety.Disarm` | command | — · timeout 3000 ms · SUCCEEDED/REJECTED/FAILED/TIMED_OUT | Request disarming. |
| `Robot.Safety.IsArmed` | sensor | bool maxAge 300 ms | Mode is MANUAL, AUTO or MOTION. |
| `Robot.Safety.IsReady` | sensor | bool maxAge 300 ms | Sensors and stack are healthy enough to arm. |
| `Robot.Safety.IsStopLatched` | sensor | bool maxAge 300 ms | Mode is SAFE_STOP; a reset is required. |
| `Robot.Safety.Mode` | sensor | enum {DISARMED, MANUAL, AUTO, MOTION, SAFE_STOP} maxAge 300 ms | Arbiter mode. |
| `Robot.Safety.Reason` | sensor | string maxAge 300 ms | Human-readable reason of the last mode change or refusal. |
| `Robot.Safety.ResetStop` | command | — · timeout 3000 ms · SUCCEEDED/REJECTED/FAILED/TIMED_OUT | Clear a latched stop (robot returns to DISARMED). |
| `Robot.Safety.Stop` | command | — · timeout 1000 ms · SUCCEEDED/FAILED/TIMED_OUT | Latched stop through the independent safety lane; always accepted. |
| `Robot.Safety.StopEvent` | event | Source: enum {OPERATOR, WORKFLOW, WATCHDOG, SENSOR, UNKNOWN}; Reason: string | Emitted when the robot enters SAFE_STOP. |
